description: Run Claude Code sessions as tasks: see who is running or waiting, approve tool calls, and review changes turn by turn.
viewContainer.title: Foreman
config.claudePath: Path to the `claude` executable. Leave empty to search `PATH` and `~/.local/bin`.
config.defaultModel: Model for new tasks (for example `claude-sonnet-5`). Leave empty to use the Claude Code default.
config.notifications: Which task events show a notification.
config.notifications.all: Waiting for input, finished and failed.
config.notifications.waiting: Only when a task waits for your input.
config.defaultPermissionMode: How tool calls are approved in new tasks.
config.defaultPermissionMode.default: Ask before every tool call (the Claude Code default).
config.defaultPermissionMode.acceptEdits: Allow file edits automatically; ask for everything else.
config.taskViewWidth: Maximum width of the task view content, in em. 0 uses the full width.
config.useWorktree: Run new tasks in a git worktree by default. You can still choose per task.
config.worktreeBranchPrefix: Prefix for the branch of each task worktree, for example `foreman/`.
config.toolCalls: How tool calls are shown in the task view.
config.toolCalls.collapsed: One summary line per group; click to expand.
config.autoTitle: Ask a small model for a short task title right after a task is created. Uses one short request per task.
config.titleModel: Model used to write task titles.
config.notificationChannel: Where to show notifications. `desktop` writes to the inbox of the Local Notifier extension (shou6.vscode-local-notifier) for Windows desktop notifications.
config.notificationChannel.desktop: Desktop notifications through Local Notifier only.
config.settingSources: Which Claude Code settings the tasks load: `user` (~/.claude/settings.json), `project` (.claude/settings.json) and `local` (.claude/settings.local.json). Remove `user` to keep your personal hooks and permission rules out of Foreman tasks.
